name: ClientArchive
description: A creator-owned archive marker that hides a derived CRM customer row while preserving its appointment and inquiry history

client_key.description: Stable derived customer row key, such as client:phone:+972... or lead:phone:+972...

display_name.description: Customer name captured when the row was archived

phone.description: Customer phone snapshot captured when the row was archived

email.description: Customer email snapshot captured when the row was archived

archived_at.description: ISO timestamp when the derived customer row was archived

source_status.description: Source row status when archived, such as active, new, or lead
